title: ReviewerResult@1 payload
description: What one reviewer attempt returned. Its reports are FindingReport@1 payloads carried inside the result — the kernel assigns them identity when it admits them, which is why a reviewer cannot name a Finding it has not been given.

verdict.description: The reviewer's overall judgement. Evidence for a human, never authority: it does not gate, resolve, or converge anything on its own.

reports.description: Immutable claims, in the order the reviewer made them. An empty list is a real answer — a reviewer that found nothing is not a reviewer that failed.

benchmark_demands.description: Proof this reviewer wants before a performance claim is believed. A demand, not a finding: it asserts nothing except that nothing has been measured.

disputes.description: This reviewer's position on claims it was given. The only channel by which one reviewer's verdict on another's claim reaches the ledger.
